exposure: educational intervention based on the theory of planned behavior
cohort: The study included 130 primigravidae women who intended to have an elective cesarean section and were referred to health centers in Neyshabour, Iran.
finding: The educational intervention significantly changed primigravidae women's attitude, subjective norm, perceived behavioral control, and intention towards elective CS.
mod_finding: The intervention was effective in decreasing the intention for elective cesarean section among primigravidae women.
